subject: math

objective.text: Estimate sums by rounding. Choose a way to round that gives a close estimate, then check your exact answer.

explanations.title: Estimate by rounding
explanations.text: Round each number, then add. 362 rounds to 400 and 159 rounds to 200. The estimate is 600.

explanations.title: Choose how to round
explanations.text: Rounding to tens gives 360 plus 160, which is 520. Rounding to fifties gives 350 plus 150, which is 500. The actual sum is 521.

explanations.title: Numbers near halfway
explanations.text: 349 rounds to 300 but 352 rounds to 400. When numbers are near halfway, round to tens or fifties for a closer estimate.

explanations.title: Why estimate
explanations.text: A close estimate helps you check if your exact answer makes sense.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 2 (S: We want to see if our exact answer makes sense.)

examples.title: 362 plus 159
examples.text: Hundreds: 600. Tens: 520. Fifties: 500. Actual: 521. Rounding to tens was closest.

examples.title: One up, one down
examples.text: 352 rounds up and 145 rounds down. They balance, so 400 plus 100 is 500, close to 497.

questions.text: Count by sixes: 36, 42, 48. What number comes next?
Round 362 and 159 to the nearest hundred. What is the estimated sum?
Round 362 and 159 to the nearest ten. What is the estimated sum?
362 plus 159. What is the actual sum?
Which estimate for 362 plus 159 is closest: 600, 520 or 500? Why?
352 plus 145 equals 497. Round each to the nearest hundred. What is the estimate?
349 plus 145 is 494, but rounding to hundreds gives 400. Why is the estimate so far off?
A doctor prescribes 175 milliliters on Monday and 256 milliliters on Tuesday. Precisely how much in both days?
Estimate 175 milliliters plus 256 milliliters by rounding to the nearest ten.
Janet watches a 94 minute movie and a 151 minute movie. How many minutes does she actually watch?
Sadie the bear weighs 182 kilograms. Her cub weighs 74 kilograms. Estimate their total weight.
Jesse practices 165 minutes and then 245 minutes. Estimate the total by rounding to the nearest 10 minutes.
Dena reads 361 minutes and 212 minutes. What is the actual total?
How does estimating help you check if your answer is reasonable?
